method_evidence.claim: The entire model has approximately 7.9B total parameters, of which 3.05B (the DiT and conditioners) are trainable.
method_evidence.anchor: The entire model has approximately 7.9B total parameters, of which 3.05B (the DiT and conditioners) are trainable.

method_evidence.claim: We train the DiT backbone and all learnable conditioning modules for approximately 80k steps on a total batch size of 5120.

method_evidence.claim: We use the AdamW optimizer with a learning rate of 5e-5, with β1 = 0.9, β2 = 0.999, and a weight decay of 1e-3.
